name: academic-mask-attack
trigger: When a prompt uses academic language and references credible sources to ask for detailed insights or step-by-step guides on sensitive topics.
strategy: This attack disguises harmful intent by framing requests for illegal activities as legitimate academic inquiries, using formal language and credible references to create a veneer of scholarly legitimacy.
guidance: Identify prompts that request detailed instructions on sensitive topics using academic language and credible sources. Scrutinize the true intent behind the request for insights or guides.
